title: Luscious and Creamy Uruguayan Chicken Lasagna
description: A savory, creamy post-workout dish from Uruguay featuring sweet sherry and lamination-puff.
instructions: Cook the lamination-puff pastry according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the mushrooms, onion, and garlic until tender.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned.
Add the sweet sherry to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked chicken mixture, mushrooms, and Grana Padano cheese.
In a separate bowl, combine the Béchamel sauce and chopped parsley.
Spread a layer of the Béchamel sauce on the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, followed by half of the chicken mixture and half of the Béchamel sauce.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the chicken mixture, and finally the Béchamel sauce.
Top the lasagna with the cooked lamination-puff pastry and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Remove the lasagna from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
